minor.issue: Does not exist (405, only DELETE /api/logs); logs are only exposed via GET /api/dashboard. Review request referenced /api/logs — not a bug per se, tests use dashboard.logs.

ui_bugs.issue: While the currently-selected symbol is being validated (usually the first one), the all-button shows no spinner/symbol (condition `wfLoading !== symbol`), so for the first ~4s it looks idle; observed states never included BTCUSDT.

action_items: LOW: show spinner on 'Validar todos' for every symbol of a batch run (track a separate batch flag instead of wfLoading !== symbol).

Consider (design): walk_forward()/run_check never uses the applied symbol_params — it re-optimizes per fold and validates the optimization process, so 'params' in results is informational only. E.g. BTC applied 3×/6×/10 while current robust best is 1×/4×/10; the 'Mantener'/'Quitar parámetros' semaphore and Telegram message speak about the applied params. Either also report OOS of the applied params, or clarify the wording.
critical_code_review_comments: wfcheck.run_check passes no params to walk_forward: revalidation verdict is independent of the actual applied SL/TP values (see action item).
OptimizerSummary.decide uses r.applied only as a boolean; it doesn't check that applied params == r.best, so 'Mantener' can be shown when applied params differ from the current robust optimum.
wf_verdict fallback uses check.results[SYM] even if symbol_params for that pair changed after the check (stale verdict for different params). Minor.

Job state is in-memory (wfcheck.job); a backend reload (uvicorn --reload also watches backend/tests/) mid-run loses it -> UI polling sees 'idle'. Acceptable for single worker but note that editing test files reloads the backend.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily applied symbol_params BTC/ETH and ran checks; restored symbol_params={} and deleted wf_checks at the end.
